ranking: precision@5 = relevant returned top-five / 5 (missing slots count zero)
recall@5 = relevant returned top-five / all labeled relevant in cohort
reciprocal rank of first labeled relevant
Apply the same shared structured guard tier ascending before descending score then ascending NCT ID; no threshold or tuning.
safety: false exclusions: omitted or hard-excluded fixture without known structured incompatibility
false eligibility claims: eligibility asserted despite unresolved criteria
unknown preservation for missing eligibility and geo
metrics.timing: One wall-clock observation per profile; Basic compute and native end-to-end Decisions separately. No latency significance claims.
metrics.cost: Unavailable: existing native protocol does not expose actual usage or invoice cost.

limitations: No independent human clinical gold labels. Exploratory evidence-derived ranking comparison only.
Exact condition overlap favors lexical ranking and ignores synonyms, disease stage, treatment appropriateness and eligibility.
Purposive small public cohort; not representative or a clinical-quality benchmark.
Synthetic fixtures are local-only deterministic checks, not sent to OpenAI.
Native protocol proves neither actual Chrome workflow nor rendered UI wording.
Native live request says fictional:false / REAL as fixed production metadata; all profiles in this evaluation are invented; do not change native packet.
stopRule: One request per profile. Stop on any permission, rate, network, invalid-result or frozen-record mismatch; no retries or substitutions.
